Consumed by choices._rank_trinkets (precise synergy instead of the substring read) and value.minion_value (W_TRINKET term).

BG36_MagicItem_403.note: Your minions have +1 Attack, improved by every card discarded this game (Hammer of Twilight, LESSER). Read from the client card data rather than the name: BG36_MagicItem_403 is the Lesser (+1 Attack, type Lesser) and BG36_MagicItem_403t the Greater (+2/+1). The two shared a name AND a read until 2026-09-23 — exactly the Lesser/Greater aliasing risk the discard doc logged as assumption A3 — so the Lesser now carries its own floor. Board-wide on the spell-point scale: 6 minions x 1 Attack = 6, growing with the discard count, undiscounted because the floor is already low.

BG36_MagicItem_404.note: After you cast a Tavern spell, give your Deity +4/+4 (Corrupted Baton, LESSER; the Greater BG36_MagicItem_404t is +10/+10 and the two shared a read until 2026-09-23). Same shape as the Greater read — spell-fuelled DEITY POOL, not board stats, paid out only when the Deity awakens — scaled to the printed numbers (4 vs 10).

BG36_MagicItem_416.note: After your Deity awakens, give it Reborn (Evil Experiment, Greater). Reborn on the build's payoff body: priced with the other Reborn-on-a-body trinkets (Converter Portrait 8, Eternal Portrait 8, Ophidian Staff 8), discounted to 6 because it does nothing until the Deity awakens (three friendly Aberration deaths, and the 50/50 head).

BG36_MagicItem_430.note: Get a Sludge Corrosion, and another after every card you discard (Sludge Portrait, Greater). Priced with the recurring generators (Shath'Yar Shrine 10 for a random Aberration per discarded spell) but one lower: what it generates is a fixed +1/+1 spell (BG36_301t, which casts twice if the trinket's own copies are discarded), so the payoff is smaller than a random-Aberration stream — 8 for the immediate copy plus the discard-rate stream.

BG36_MagicItem_403t.note: Your minions have +2/+1, improved by every card discarded this game (Hammer of Twilight, Greater; the Lesser BG36_MagicItem_403 is +1 Attack, read separately since 2026-09-23). Board-wide: on the spell-point scale (1 stat point = 1 pt) a 6-minion board is ~18 and grows with the discard count, discounted to 16 because the buff needs a wide board to pay off. First entry to use the 36.6.1 `discard` keyword — the Aberration tribe's theme.

BG30_MagicItem_701.note: Every fourth card you buy costs Health instead of Gold, three times (The Eye of Sargeras, Greater; guide: a Shop-Buff-Demon pick). The Health cost is NOT modelled in base_value - it is small early and dangerous in the 13-16 fragility band, where the plan's own danger clause is the thing that should veto it.

BG36_MagicItem_411.note: Discover a SECOND Hero Power and gain 3 Gold (Reinvigorating Light, Lesser). A second power is a whole extra engine per turn whose value depends on which powers the lobby offers - taken at the two-hero-power entries' scale (8) with the 3 Gold read as economy (gold 2/gold).

BG36_MagicItem_414.note: End of turn: your minions get +1/+1, and the amount DOUBLES at the start of each turn (Weighted Gauntlet, Lesser) - so turn N gives +2^(N-1)/+2^(N-1) board-wide. Priced at 12 like the other end-of-turn board scalers (Gold Mallet 12) rather than by the printed +1/+1: it needs turns to compound, which is exactly what the current value model discounts.
